{{Quote|Yirt-4138-Grek-12, a 65-kilometer diameter airless rock, became the grave-site for 25 cybernetically-enhanced data thieves when Corporate Alliance tank droids leveled a clandestine compound funded by unknown parties.|HoloNet News report|<ref name="AllianceAttacks" />}}
A '''team''' of [[Cyborg/Legends|cybernetically]]-enhanced [[Slicer/Legends|slicers]] were operating in an industrial [[Spy/Legends|espionage]] training [[Yirt-4138-Grek-12 slicer compound|center]] on the [[Asteroid/Legends|asteroid]] [[Yirt-4138-Grek-12]] in [[22 BBY/Legends|22 BBY]]. They were responsible for performing [[Cybernetics/Legends|cybernetic]] surgeries and training many espionage agents who stole data from the [[Corporate Alliance/Legends|Corporate Alliance]], one of the [[Commerce Guild/Legends|commerce guilds]]. When one of the base's agents, [[Denlace Sachoore]], was arrested for stealing data from the Alliance, the base was discovered. The Alliance decided to eliminate the organization, and a [[Raid on Yirt-4138-Grek-12|raid]] was launched on the asteroid. Several [[NR-N99 Persuader-class droid enforcer/Legends|NR-N99 ''Persuader''-class droid enforcers]] proceeded to attack the center, destroying it and [[Death/Legends|killing]] every slicer inside the facility.

==History==
{{Quote|The compound contained unauthorized cybernetic surgery suites that were churning out vessels and cyborgs that have been slicing into Corporate Alliance data-stores. This potential revenue-threat has been neutralized.|Corporate Alliance Magistrate Passel Argente|<ref name="AllianceAttacks" />}}
[[File:TankDroidHolonet.png|thumb|right|250px|The slicer team was exterminated by several NR-N99 ''Persuader''-class droid enforcers.]]
During the [[Separatist Crisis/Legends|Separatist Crisis]] in [[22 BBY/Legends|22 BBY]], a [[Cyborg/Legends|cyborg]] [[Slicer/Legends|slicer]] team funded by shadowy parties worked in a secret [[Yirt-4138-Grek-12 slicer compound|compound]] located on a remote [[Asteroid/Legends|asteroid]] named [[Yirt-4138-Grek-12]] in the [[Fakir sector/Legends|Fakir sector]], which was controlled by the [[Corporate Alliance/Legends|Corporate Alliance]], one of the many [[Commerce Guild/Legends|commerce guilds]]. In the compound, the team trained [[Spy/Legends|espionage agents]], supplying them by building [[Starship/Legends|starships]] for them and performing [[Cybernetics/Legends|cybernetic]] surgeries on them to aid in their theft of valuable data from the data stores of the Corporate Alliance. However, one of the facility's agents, [[Denlace Sachoore]]&mdash;who had received a [[Bone/Legends|cranium]]-implanted [[vessel drive]] through surgery&mdash;was caught embezzling Alliance data in the vessel drive while working as a clerk for the Alliance. The Alliance's [[expeditor]]s interrogated her, and, approximately a [[Standard month/Legends|month]] later, her espionage origins were traced to Yirt-4138-Grek-12.<ref name="AllianceAttacks" />

The facility now discovered, the [[Corporate Alliance Directorate]]&mdash;headed by [[Magistrate/Legends|Magistrate]] [[Passel Argente/Legends|Passel Argente]]&mdash;decided to neutralize the base and the team as a threat to their revenues. Several [[NR-N99 Persuader-class droid enforcer/Legends|NR-N99 ''Persuader''-class droid enforcers]] were [[Transport/Legends|transported]] to the asteroid, where they [[Raid on Yirt-4138-Grek-12|attacked]] the base with their [[Laser/Legends|laser]] and [[Missile/Legends|missile]] weaponry. The structure was breached and de-pressurized, and twenty-five cyborgs [[Death/Legends|perished]] inside it. Their deaths were later reported in Magistrate Argente's [[Hologram/Legends|holomessage]] to shareholders of the Alliance, and in an article of [[HoloNet News/Legends|HoloNet News]].<ref name="AllianceAttacks" />

==Organization==
{{Quote|A rash of corporate thievery was discovered in the Fakir sector last month with the arrest of Denlace Sachoore, a 24-year old Corporate Alliance clerk found embezzling data in a cranium-implanted vessel drive.|HoloNet News report|<ref name="AllianceAttacks" />}}
The team consisted of individuals with knowledge of slicing who had undergone surgery that enhanced them with cybernetics. Their compound on Yirt-4138-Grek-12 contained several suites that were used to produce starships and perform surgeries, as well as train agents. These unauthorized operations were illegal according to the laws of the [[Galactic Republic/Legends|Galactic Republic]], the ruling government of [[The galaxy/Legends|the galaxy]], and the organization was kept hidden by its financiers. While the team showed creativity with their cybernetics, such as the vessel drive, Denlace Sachoore's capture led to the downfall of the whole group. As they were located in Alliance [[Realspace/Legends|space]], the raid which claimed their lives fell within legal boundaries.<ref name="AllianceAttacks" />

==Behind the scenes==
The team was first mentioned in the [[in-universe]] [[HoloNet News Vol. 531 48|''HoloNet News Vol. 531 #48'']] article ''Corporate Alliance Attacks Slicer Compound'', part of the [[HoloNet News (original website)|HoloNet News]] volume<ref name="AllianceAttacks" /> released on [[March 21]], [[2002]]<ref name="JFC">{{JCFCite|url=posts/6128630|board=Literature|thread=The Official HoloNetNews Discussion Thread|user=PrinceXizor|date=2002-03-21|time=3:24 PM|quote=Issue 48 is up !}}</ref> and written by [[Pablo Hidalgo]] and [[Paul Ens]].<ref name="HNN Credits">{{HoloNetNewsWeb||credits.html|Credits}}</ref>
